name: agent-notify
description: Deploy-to-Cloudflare email notifications for your AI agents (HTTP + MCP)

TO_ADDRESS.description: Where alerts go. Must be a **verified destination address** ([Email Routing → Destination addresses](https://dash.cloudflare.com/?to=/:account/email-service/routing)).

FROM_ADDRESS.description: Sender, e.g. `alerts@yourdomain.com`. Its domain must be **onboarded for sending** ([Email Sending → Onboard Domain](https://dash.cloudflare.com/?to=/:account/email-service/sending)). Don't enable Email Routing on a domain that already receives mail.

KV.description: Stores your generated access token. Leave the default.

DAILY_LIMIT.description: Max emails per day. The default `100` keeps you within Cloudflare's included quota, so this can never cost money. Leave it unless you need more.
